_comment: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan (subscription). Run `cowork-zai-login` after install to mint the credential via the ZCode OAuth flow; the proxy holds the real key, so ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN below is only a gating sentinel (any >=32-char string). GLM 5.2 is text-only; image requests escalate to glm-4.6v. Using the Coding Plan outside the official ZCode client is a ToS grey area.
